sources.note: ARIA CORE product page. Describes it as a modernized oncology management system with single sign-on, Eclipse integration, Noona integration, ARIA CORE Insights, and new Systemic Therapy Management module.
Legacy ARIA OIS product page. Confirms ARIA OIS is now classified as a legacy solution. Describes comprehensive information and image management for radiation, medical, and surgical oncology.

Siemens Healthineers ARIA OIS page. Describes three user groups (administrators, physicians, physicists/dosimetrists). Mentions EQUICARE CS survivorship integration and Eclipse treatment planning integration.
ONC certification mandatory disclosures PDF. Could not extract content (PDF viewer only), but URL confirms the certification document exists for ARIA CORE v16.1/18.1/18.2.

EMRFinder profile. 4/5 stars from 7 reviews. Users praise integration between treatment planning and scheduling. Criticisms include clunky interface and steep learning curve. Cloud-based, ONC-certified.
EMRSystems profile. Notes partnership with Unlimited Systems Centricity for practice management. Users describe easy document uploading but mention glitches. 4-star average from 2 reviews.
EHR in Practice profile page for ARIA. Could not fully access (403) but search results confirmed it as a pricing/demo comparison resource.
Market share data: 369 companies use ARIA, 0.8% EHR market share. 85% US customers, 65% hospital/healthcare, 59% large organizations (1000+ employees), 55% with $1B+ revenue.

2013 PMC article on implementing ARIA at Duke University Health System. Describes hybrid EMR approach with ARIA for radiation oncology-specific data alongside enterprise EHR. Details data types: treatment planning orders, prescriptions, treatment plans, daily therapy records, QA reports, on-treatment images.
ARIA CORE iOS mobile app. Features include viewing patient data, scheduling, document approvals, note dictation, lab tests, vital signs. Requires ARIA v15.5 MR2 or higher.
Signify Research analysis of Siemens-Varian acquisition (April 2021, $16.4B). Notes Varian as leading best-of-breed OIS vendor in US. Combined portfolio covers most oncology IT workflow.
2024 Ballad Health deal — 10-year oncology collaboration including TrueBeam linacs, Ethos adaptive radiotherapy, and ARIA CORE cloud-based oncology management system.
ASTRO 2024 press release from Varian/Siemens Healthineers highlighting software innovations including ARIA CORE and Systemic Therapy Management.
